purpose: Fill remaining Prayer / Fishing / Runecrafting / Farming / Firemaking training-method gaps called out by audit-ironman-gaps-crosscheck-2026-07-26. Skip anything already present as a training method in data/research/catalog.json (Seedicide combat multi; Bonfire log burning Yeti/Prif/Max; Vyrelord auto-cremation FM; generic Abyss/Runespan/PoF/Ranch rows). No invented XP/h — only wiki-stated multipliers, ironman-guide rates, and activity pages. Region IDs use Equilibrium electives; Fort Forinthry keeps working Catalyst→misthalin mapping with forinthry dual-label; City of Um / Land of Snow portal taxonomy uses misthalin / asgarnia respectively.

skipped_already_in_catalog.method: Seedicide combat multi (destroy seed drops for double plant XP)
Bonfire log burning (Yeti Town / Prif / Max Guild)

methods.level_range: 18-61 ironman outfit path; usable any Prayer level for worship
methods.xp_rate: 4x bury/scatter XP per remains (400% base) — e.g. dragon bones 288 Prayer XP / worship; wiki ironman path uses ashes to skip grinding. ~700 worships/h cited on pay-to-play Prayer training (incl. slime + grind overhead). No continuous XP/h table for the 1,200-worship outfit grind.
methods.intensity: active bank runs; slime pit + bone grinder (or ashes skip grind); ectophial teleports
methods.location: Ectofuntus temple, Port Phasmatys (Morytania); shady ghost sells First Age pieces on ground floor
methods.notes: Ironman Guide/Prayer 18-61: bank 1,200 buckets of slime + 1,200 ash remains (ash tier does not change ecto-token count), worship for ecto-tokens. Full First Age set + tiara add-on = 6,000 ecto-tokens (1,000 each piece / add-on; 5 tokens per worship → 1,200 worships). Outfit: +1% Prayer XP per piece, +1% set bonus = 6% total when full set worn. Outfit does NOT apply at Ectofuntus itself (nor God Statues / urns) — value is for later altar / powder / vyre offering. Ghosts Ahoy ectophial strongly recommended. Robin medium/hard/elite Morytania diary converts daily bones→bonemeal+slime (13/26/39).
methods.warning: Slower XP/h than Fort/gilded/chaos offering but permanent 6% Prayer outfit. First Age XP does not work while worshipping Ectofuntus.

methods.level_range: any Prayer once chapel built; Construction 15/55/90 for tiers 1/2/3
methods.xp_rate: Tier multipliers of bury XP: T1 200%, T2 250%, T3 300% (post-16-Feb-2026 rebalance; previously higher). Chapel burners add 3%/6%/10% chance to save offerings by tier (shared world timer). Wiki pay-to-play table models ~1,900 bones/h at T3 with bank chest adjacency. Effective average with T3 10% save re-offer ~333% bury XP (geometric series).
methods.intensity: bank-chest click intensive offering; optional W84 shared burners
methods.location: Chapel altar, Fort Forinthry (bank chest in building)
methods.notes: Requires New Foundations + building chapel blueprints (oak/acadia/elder frames + stone wall segments). Burners fueled with clean herbs (noted OK); timer stacks up to 168h and is shared per world — W84 common. Prayer brawling gloves stack here (and gilded) but not with Ectofuntus/chaos. Dual region label: Catalyst/working League taxonomy maps Fort content to misthalin; physical site is SE Wilderness edge — forinthry dual-ok for planner until Equilibrium hard boundary.
methods.warning: Region dual-label misthalin (working) / forinthry (geography). Feb 2026 patch cut chapel XP bonuses 50% so POH gilded (350% with both burners) now beats Fort on raw multiplier; Fort still wins on bank proximity + material-save chance.

methods.method: POH gilded altar (both incense burners lit)
methods.level_range: 75 Construction unboosted for gilded altar; boostable from ~65 (crystal saw + sculpting chisel + orange spicy stew)
methods.xp_rate: Up to 350% bury XP with both incense burners lit (wiki multiplier table). Perfect juju prayer can push further (~367.5% cited on pay-to-play Prayer training). ~1,524 bones/h in wiki comparison table (guest/house logistics).
methods.intensity: house guest world 31 open altars, or self-built with burner maintenance
methods.location: Player-owned house Chapel room (gilded altar hotspot); official open-altar world 31 Taverley
methods.notes: Highest standard altar multiplier. Requires house Chapel furniture + lit oak/mahogany/marble incense burners (or Prayer cape substitute noted on gilded altar page). House location is player-chosen (not region-locked once Construction/planks available). First Age outfit stacks on POH offering (unlike Ectofuntus). Ironman Guide/Prayer lists POH altar alongside Chaos altar and Fort chapel for 40-75+ sacrifice path.
methods.warning: Open-altar hosting is sparse — ironmen usually self-build. Does not grant Fort-style offering-save chance.

methods.level_range: 93-99+ Fishing (tier 1 93 / tier 2 95 / tier 3 97); 90 Agility + 90 Strength + 90 Ranged boostable for grapple access
methods.xp_rate: Wiki pay-to-play: up to ~119,000 XP/h at 99 base table row; ~130,000 XP/h high-tier base at 99; up to ~200,000 with buffs; strategy section up to ~330,000 with full stack (fury shark + crystal rod Honed/Furnace + urns + juju + scrimshaw + familiar + avatar + incense + Inspire Effort + large-urchin shop XP) and well over 450,000 approaching 500,000 with Scripture of Elidinis / crystal skillchompas / Tavia's rod.
methods.intensity: semi-AFK crystal urchin fishing with periodic big/leaping urchin and geyser events
methods.location: Prifddinas Waterfall between Meilyr and Crwys districts; bank chest on tier-2 platform; shop at base
methods.notes: Plague's End required. Grapple short-cut or waterfall fishing teleports (300 urchin points) or Max Guild skilling portal. Small/medium/large crystal urchins → shop points; 3,000 Fishing XP per 300 points after unlocks. Also unlocks crystal fishing rod recipe (3,000 points + tool seed path) — rod already catalogued as Tirannwn tool unlock; this row is the XP method. Voice of Seren does not affect waterfall Fishing XP. Ironman guide: stay at least until crystal rod; optional 93-94/99 before Frenzy.
methods.warning: Hard Tirannwn (Prif) elective. Combat/agility grapple gates are boostable but portal attune is not.

methods.xp_rate: 130 Fishing XP per catch; up to ~100,000 XP/h at 99 (wiki training table); pay-to-play detail ~90,000–100,000 base at 99. Slightly lower XP/h than crystallise fly fishing but longest AFK fishing method.
methods.intensity: full lobby-timer AFK with porters or fury shark consume; otherwise short bank west of spot
methods.location: Ghostly sole spot at Reflection Pool, southern City of Um (one permanent non-moving spot)
methods.notes: Requires Necromancy! quest. Bait + fishing rod. Passing bracelet 'City of Um: Reflection Pool' teleports next to the spot. Ironman guide lists 66+ AFK XP and food route (1,650 LP cooked). Working League taxonomy: City of Um / Underworld → misthalin.
methods.warning: Starting-region path under Um taxonomy — no elective if Misthalin/Um already available. Not a high XP ceiling method.

methods.level_range: 70-93 Fishing recommended window; 88 Magic + The Light Within for Crystallise; Light Form (Seren prayer) for full bonus
methods.xp_rate: Up to 118,000 Fishing XP/h at 99 with Crystallise + Light Form (pay-to-play Fishing training). Up to ~11,400 Magic XP/h if recasting Crystallise every 30s. Without Crystallise, barbarian leaping fish ~63,000 XP/h at 70 is the ironman alt for 70-72.
methods.intensity: high click — recast Crystallise ~120 times/h; manage Light Form prayer drain
methods.location: Any fly-fishing trout/salmon spot (common: Lumbridge / Shilo Village / barbarian setups); spell is global once unlocked
methods.notes: Crystallise: +20% Fishing XP on the spot for 30s but no resources caught; costs 6 water + 6 fire + 6 chaos + 6 soul runes per cast. Light Form further enhances Seren-aligned crystallise bonus (wiki equipment table: crystallised spot additional XP up to 87.5% from 50% baseline with Light Form). Soul rune supply is the ironman bottleneck (Desert soul altar / Runespan / other). Ironman guide: optimal XP 70-93 when available; else Menafish 72-93.
methods.warning: Multi-region: fly spots often Misthalin/Karamja/Kandarin; spell+prayer unlock is Tirannwn (The Light Within). Soul runes add Desert/Runespan supply pressure. Extremely soul-rune intensive.

methods.level_range: quest-gated via Rune Mythos; miasma runes from 60 RC (milestone table); spirit/miasma/flesh/bone altars in temple
methods.xp_rate: Wiki ironman guide: XP comparable to Abyss runecrafting (no fixed XP/h published on the ironman page). Optimised output guides on individual necrotic rune pages are not reproduced here.
methods.intensity: active altar runs; impure essence prep via Necromancy rituals (pure essence focus + ink + necroplasm)
methods.location: Necromantic Rune Temple via dark portal at Haunt on the Hill, northeastern City of Um — Spirit (N), Miasma (E), Flesh (S), Bone (W) altars
methods.notes: Unlocked through Rune Mythos. Convenient teleport/surge path makes it a strong alternate to Abyss for ironmen. Impure essence is ritual-produced, not pure essence. Working City of Um taxonomy → misthalin. Double surge (Anachronia Agility) / Bladed Dive noted as optimisation, not required for basic method.
methods.warning: No wiki XP/h on ironman RC page — treat as method unlock + supply chain (rituals), not a ranked rate. Do not invent Abyss-parity numbers.

methods.level_range: 77-90 Runecrafting (Legacy of Seergaze for blood altar)
methods.xp_rate: No fixed XP/h on ironman RC guide — described as quick experience vs Runespan but essence-heavy and more intense. Prefer after banking large pure essence from Slayer/PvM.
methods.intensity: active Abyss navigation + altar runs; pouch management
methods.location: Wilderness Mage of Zamorak Abyss entrance → blood altar inner path; pure essence supply multi-source
methods.notes: Named ironman alternate for 77-90 before soul runes (90, 'Phite Club). Abyss runs also roll magical threads for rune pouches. Pure essence: Rune chest after Rune Memories; abyssal savages; other PvM. Generic Abyss runecrafting already in catalog — this row pins blood-specific mid ladder.
methods.warning: Forinthry/Wilderness Abyss risk. Rates not published as a single number on ironman guide — do not invent.

methods.level_range: up to 92 RC to siphon initial soul layer; dust exchange usable once daily after collecting
methods.xp_rate: Up to 25,000 Runecrafting XP per day exchanging 1,000 rune dust on Pure energy after a fully broken-down runesphere. Siphon XP during the sphere is separate and layer-dependent (not tabulated here).
methods.intensity: D&D interrupt during Runespan; ~2–3.5 min per layer; ~1 hour full break-down if attended
methods.location: Runespan (any of 3 levels when sphere spawns ~every 2.5 hours); enter via Wizards' Tower portals (Misthalin). Runesphere teleport tablets 2,000 Runespan points each.
methods.notes: Daily: max 1,000 rune dust/day from siphoning. Exchange once/day on Pure energy left after complete break-down. Chat/interface shows floor. Ironman dailies section — stack with Runespan training, not a primary ladder.
methods.warning: Hard daily cap 25k XP from dust — not continuous training. Requires finding/attending a sphere.

methods.level_range: 1-30 ironman early path (usable later as daily)
methods.xp_rate: Daily repeatable only — not continuous XP/h. Three Farming actions available per day (wiki ironman Farming guide). Exact XP per action via wiki Nemi Forest calculator (instance-dependent fungal growths / goebie tasks).
methods.location: Nemi Forest, north-west Mazcab overworld (Liberation of Mazcab / Goebie access path)
methods.notes: Ironman Guide/Farming opens with Nemi Forest for 1-30. Mazcab is not an Equilibrium elective region id — treat as multi-region / quest-unlocked daily content, not a region-pick driver. Also listed under Prayer repeatable events on ironman Prayer guide.
methods.warning: Not continuous training. Mazcab access gates (quests/minigame) apply. Do not invent XP/h.

methods.xp_rate: Wiki Het's Oasis bush table (no compost): Rose 17,500 XP/h (850 XP/bush); Iris 26,000 XP/h (1,266); Hydrangea 37,600 XP/h (1,883); Hollyhock 91,000 XP/h (2,883). Cultivation ticks award 1/2/3 XP on bare/budding/blooming stages before harvest bonus.
methods.intensity: active cultivate/harvest loop at oasis bush patches
methods.location: Het's Oasis flower bush spots (rose NW, iris, hydrangea, hollyhock corners per wiki map pins)
methods.notes: Ironman Guide/Farming continuous XP 30-99 alongside PoF. Flowers feed PoF beehive honeycombs (fertile/candied/nutritious/moreish/shimmering from golden roses). Compost / fertile soil / rapid growth / Farming master cape supercompost interactions documented on Het's Oasis page.
methods.warning: XP/h is wiki table for bush method — setup dependent (compost, ticks). Desert elective.

methods.method: Standard herb and tree patch run summary
methods.level_range: 1-99+ progressive (allotments early; herbs mid; trees/fruit trees long cycle; magic trees 75+)
methods.xp_rate: Time-gated patch runs — not a continuous XP/h method. XP equals plant+check-health+harvest tables per seed (see individual seed pages). Ironman guide emphasises supercompost and saving herb seeds until 50 Farming for Crux Eqal favour herbs.
methods.intensity: teleport patch circuit every growth cycle
methods.location: Global patch network (allotment/herb/tree/fruit/bush hops); seed sources Master Farmers + shops + bosses
methods.notes: Ironman ladder highlights: Head Farmer Jones / Draynor Seed Market 1-17 seeds; potatoes→onions→cabbages→tomatoes early; watermelons 47-51 via Temple Trekking seeds; pineapple seedlings from Coeden (Crwys) after Plague's End; magic trees from high-end boss seeds at 75+. Supercompost: pineapples from Arhein (Catherby) or Karamja plants. Master Farmers / Garden of Kharid druids / Miscellania for herb seed income already partially catalogued as separate rows — this is the patch-run training frame those seeds feed.
methods.warning: Summary method only — no invented run XP/h. Pair with existing Master Farmer / Miscellania / seedicide rows.

methods.method: Herblore Habitat vine seeds (Papa Mambo / jadinko favour)
methods.level_range: Habitat patches + juju herb tiers; god jadinko weekly 81 Hunter for marasamaw
methods.xp_rate: Not primary continuous Farming XP/h — seed/shop/favour supply for vine herbs/bushes + weekly jadinko XP reward choice (Farming/Hunter/Herblore). Witchdoctor gear set can grant 5% XP during the weekly god-jadinko boost window.
methods.intensity: habitat plant setup + hunting; shop restocks
methods.location: Herblore Habitat south of Shilo Village, Karamja (Papa Mambo hut, vine herb/bush/blossom/fruit patches)
methods.notes: Ironman Farming seed section: Herblore Habitat herb seeds bought from Papa Mambo's Shop or offering jadinko favour — excluded from standard Master Farmer tables. First-time free seeds from Papa Mambo. Vine bush berries pay zombie farmer protection. Weekly catch-all regular jadinkos → XP + witchdoctor legs/robe; all three god jadinkos → extra XP + mask. Anachronia jadinko hunting is a separate simpler track.
methods.warning: Karamja automatic-early in many League setups — still tag karamja for habitat geography. Do not invent Habitat XP/h.

methods.level_range: 1-15 normal → 15-30 oak → 30-35 willow → 35-45 teak → 45-75/110 maple → 50-75 mahogany → 75-82 magic (acadia 47-75 better as Invention simple components ~4% junk)
methods.xp_rate: Wiki ironman Firemaking bonfire summary XP/h (with preferred permanent bonfires): normal 49,875; oak 84,787.5; willow 104,737.5; teak 119,700; maple 133,380; acadia 139,650; mahogany 167,550; magic 304,000. Per-log XP on same table: 52.5 / 89.25 / 110.25 / 126 / 140.4 / 147 / 189 / 320.
methods.intensity: banked log burn sessions; supply passive from kingdom or woodcutting
methods.location: Burn at permanent high-bonus bonfires (Yeti Town, Prif Tower of Voices, Max Guild — see existing catalog bonfire-location row). Log supply: woodcutting multi-region; teak/maple/mahogany heavily from Managing Miscellania (Fremennik).
methods.notes: Fills the early/mid ironman ladder missing from high-end curly-roots / accidental FM rows. Miscellania maple/teak/mahogany passive is the ironman supply note. Always prefer permanent bonfires for max XP (Yeti +4% as 5-player permanent after Violet is Blue; Prif Tower of Voices same XP bonus plus log-save chance). Acadia: ironman guide prefers disassemble for simple components over pure FM. Magic logs also from bosses (Croesus, Nex) when Fletching/Construction no longer need them.
methods.warning: Yeti Town / Prif burn sites already catalogued as Firemaking location method — this row is the log-tier ladder + Miscellania supply. Yeti access: Land of Snow portal at White Wolf Mountain (Taverley side) → asgarnia portal geography, not Fremennik.
